# NYC Flameproofing

> > FDNY-certified fire protection and flameproofing services for commercial buildings, hotels, restaurants, and hospitality venues in New York City since 1968.

NYC Flameproofing provides comprehensive flame retardant treatments and fireproofing solutions compliant with FDNY regulations and NFPA standards. The company specializes in commercial fireproofing, fabric treatment, and fire safety compliance for businesses throughout the Greater NYC area.

## Key Topics

- FDNY compliance and certification
- NFPA standards and regulations
- C-15 Certificate of Fitness
- Flame retardant treatment
- Commercial fireproofing procedures
- Class A flame spread rating
- Hotel and hospitality fire safety
- Field flame testing
- Fire prevention strategies
- FDNY-certified flameproofers
- Fabric and upholstery treatment
- Fire safety compliance
- Community Risk Reduction (5 Es)
- Fire statistics and data (NFPA/USFA)

## Core Services

- [NYC Flameproofing - Top Fire Proofing Company](https://nycflameproofing.com/fire-proofing): FDNY-certified fire proofing services in New York since 1968
- [NYC Flameproofing - Hotels, Bars & Restaurants](https://nycflameproofing.com/flameproofing-hotels-bars-restaurants): FDNY-compliant fire protection for NYC hospitality industry since 1968

## Compliance & Procedures

- [What are the Laws Concerning Flameproofing?](https://nycflameproofing.com/laws-concerning-flameproofing): Overview of flameproofing laws, compliance, and certification requirements
- [The Procedure for Fireproofing a Building](https://nycflameproofing.com/procedure-fireproofing-building): Guide to FDNY-compliant fireproofing procedures for commercial buildings
- [Our Responsibility to You as Certified Flameproofers](https://nycflameproofing.com/responsibility-certified-flameproofers): FDNY Certificate of Fitness requirements and flameproofing standards

## Fire Safety Resources

- [The Challenges of the Field Flame Test](https://nycflameproofing.com/the-challenges-of-the-field-flame-test): FDNY field flame test challenges and fabric treatment limitations
- [An Extra Layer of Fire Protection: Flame Retardant Paint](https://nycflameproofing.com/an-extra-layer-of-fire-protection-flame-retardant-paint): Class A/B flame retardant paint coatings for enhanced fire protection
- [Keeping NYC Hotels Safe from Fire](https://nycflameproofing.com/keeping-nyc-hotels-safe-from-fire): FDNY hotel fire safety regulations and flameproofing compliance in NYC
- [The Elements of a Community Approach to Fire Safety](https://nycflameproofing.com/the-elements-of-a-community-approach-to-fire-safety): NFPA's 5 Es of Community Risk Reduction for fire prevention planning
- [The History of Flameproofing](https://nycflameproofing.com/the-history-of-flameproofing): Historical overview of fire retardants from alum to modern treatments

## Fire Statistics & Data

- [The Story of Fires in Numbers](https://nycflameproofing.com/the-story-of-fires-in-numbers): NFPA fire statistics covering deaths, injuries, and property damage in U.S.
- [Data Re: Fires Involving Upholstered Furniture](https://nycflameproofing.com/data-re-fires-involving-upholstered-furniture): NFPA fire statistics and safety data for upholstered furniture fires
- [Data Re: Fires at Hotels and Motels](https://nycflameproofing.com/data-re-fires-at-hotels-and-motels): NFPA hotel and motel fire statistics and hospitality safety data
- [Data Re: Fires at Industrial or Manufacturing Sites](https://nycflameproofing.com/data-re-fires-at-industrial-or-manufacturing-sites): NFPA industrial and manufacturing fire statistics and prevention data
- [The Impact of Secondary Losses as a Result of Fires](https://nycflameproofing.com/impact-secondary-losses-result-fires): Secondary fire damage costs and business asset protection strategies
